scripts.text:
[Geffen Guide]
Welcome to ^8B4513Geffen^000000,
the City of Magic.
Do you need help navigating the city?

[吉芬向导]

需要我为您指引方向吗？

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[Geffen Guide]
The <NAVI>[Magic Academy]<INFO>geffen,61,180,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>
handles all magic-related affairs,
including job changes.
Let me mark its location
on your mini-map.
Would you like to check any other locations?
scripts.translation:
[吉芬向导]
<NAVI>[魔法学院]<INFO>geffen,61,180,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>负责处理所有与魔法相关的事务，包括转职。
我会在小地图上标记这里的位置。
还想查看其他地点吗？
